    Synthetic Benchmark Human Gut Microbiome Dataset

    gut_microbiome.Rd

    A realistic synthetic human gut microbiome benchmark dataset designed for testing and demonstrating modern microbiome analysis workflows. Contains 24 samples (12 Control vs. 12 Treated) and 40 amplicon sequence variants (ASVs) across 4 major bacterial phyla (Bacteroidota, Firmicutes, Actinobacteriota, and Proteobacteria).

    Usage

    data(gut_microbiome)

    Format

    A tidy_microbiome object with 24 samples and 40 taxa:

    sample_id

    Unique sample identifier (e.g. Sample_01).

    treatment

    Treatment group: Control or Treated.

    diet

    Dietary regimen: Standard or HighFiber.

    age

    Subject age in years.

    depth

    Total sequencing read count per sample.

    Source

    Synthetically generated with negative binomial dispersion, compositional closure, and realistic zero inflation mimicking Illumina NovaSeq 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing.
